title: Grandma Carter's Peanut Butter Fudge

items.body: Butter the pan. Stir the jar of natural peanut butter very well, then measure it out with the marshmallows and keep them by the stove. Step 4 moves fast.
Put the sugar, butter and Milnot in the pot over medium-high heat, stirring until it comes to a rolling boil.
Keep stirring constantly at a rolling boil until it reaches soft ball stage, 235 °F (113 °C) on the probe thermometer, ≈5 min.
Take the pot off the heat. Add the peanut butter and marshmallows and stir until they melt and the mixture is smooth. Pour into the buttered pan right away.
Let it cool at room temperature until firm, ≈2 h. Cut 6 × 10 into pieces.

nutritionSource: USDA FoodData Central: SR Legacy (sugar, butter) and Branded Foods labels (Milnot, 2 tbsp = 30 mL = 40 kcal, 30 mg, 2 g; Smucker’s Natural; Jet-Puffed Mini, 30 g = 100 kcal, 25 mg, 0 g). Butter for the pan not counted.
notes: Milnot is canned evaporated filled milk. Regular evaporated milk works the same way, cup for cup.
The card says “soft boil on candy thermometer”, which means soft ball stage, and “1 small pkg small marshmallows”, taken here as a 10 oz bag. “Large buttered pan or dish” is taken as 13 × 9.
Natural peanut butter can set softer than the regular kind. If it’s too soft to cut cleanly, chill it first.
